title: Analog Resonant Recurrent Neural Networks via Metacircuits
abstract: arXiv:2604.17277v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physical neural networks offer a promising route to fast and energy-efficient edge intelligence by embedding computation in the intrinsic dynamics of materials and devices. However, processing temporal signals requires recurrent networks with memory, whose trained dynamics are hard to reproduce faithfully in physical systems. Here we present an analog resonant recurrent neural network (R$^2$NN) implemented as a metacircuit of coupled local resonators. A reformulated mechanical-electrical analogy based on frequency-dependent negative resistances maps a trained network one-to-one onto the metacircuit, with every trainable parameter realized as a resistance. Training tunes local resonances and global resistive couplings so that past responses persist as recurrent memory and interfere with incoming inputs, and the resulting impedance landscape routes different frequencies to distinct outputs. translated_title: 基于超电路的模拟谐振循环神经网络
translated_abstract: 物理神经网络通过将计算嵌入材料与器件的固有动态特性中，为实现快速且节能的边缘智能提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，处理时序信号需要具有记忆功能的循环网络，而其训练后的动态特性难以在物理系统中被忠实复现。在此，我们提出了一种以耦合局部谐振器构成的超电路形式实现的模拟谐振循环神经网络（R²NN）。基于频率相关负电阻的重新构建的机电类比，可将训练好的网络一一映射到超电路上，其中每个可训练参数均被实现为一个电阻。训练过程调节局部谐振和全局电阻耦合，使过去的响应作为循环记忆持续存在并与输入信号发生干涉，由此形成的阻抗特性将不同频率路由到不同的输出端。利用这种循环记忆，该……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种由耦合局部谐振器超电路实现的模拟谐振循环神经网络（R²NN），通过基于频率相关负电阻的机电类比将训练后的网络参数一一映射为电阻，使过去的响应作为循环记忆与输入干涉，从而实现按频率路由信号的高效物理智能计算。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an analog resonant recurrent neural network (R²NN) implemented as a metacircuit of coupled local resonators, where a mechanical-electrical analogy based on frequency-dependent negative resistances maps every trainable parameter one-to-one onto a resistance, allowing past responses to persist as recurrent memory that interferes with inputs and routes different frequencies to distinct outputs.
